text:
Devin (procurement): Vendor just flagged a partial DOA on an H100 batch, asking for routing decision — AMS cross-dock or FRA depot? need quick take on customs and insurance.
Hana (logistics): AMS preferred for simpler customs clearance, FRA faster dock. which site owns the receipts?
Devin (procurement): Vendor only has 3 immediate replacements in EU pool; other 3 backordered ~21 days. They propose split ship: 3 air expedited, 3 sea top-up. We need approval for expedite cost and depot selection.
Michaela (ops): What's the expedite delta per GPU? we must justify to finance.
Anna (vendor-ops): Hi — air extra per unit (D2D incl insurance) = €1,250, sea = €300. AMS cross-dock handling €45/unit. We can consolidate paperwork but serials separated.
Oliver (sre): Ops question — if replacements arrive staggered, can cluster hot-swap without >4h reprovisioning? if not, we need loaners.
Michaela (ops): We have 2 hot-swap loaners staged in DE-FRA for 72h. If replacements exceed 72h, we should rent additional loaners.
Hana (logistics): Vendor suggested HS code 8471.50.00, declare as "spare parts" to speed customs. ok?
Anna (vendor-ops): Confirm HS 8471.50.00 is correct. We'll mark invoice as spare parts and include supporting tech spec to expedite.
Devin (procurement): Approve AMS cross-dock + 3-air expedited. Please send PO increment for the expedite delta; vendor to confirm AWB.
VendorBot: AWB created: 987-6543210, manifest link: https://vendor.example/awb/987-6543210
Anna (vendor-ops): Manifest (partial):
```
AWB: 987-6543210
SKU: H100-80GB
Qty_ship: 3
Repl_serials: H100-00089,H100-00090,H100-00091
Return_serials: H100-00045,H100-00046,H100-00047
Depot_dest: NL-AMS-CROSSDOCK
ETA: 2024-06-15
```
Michaela (ops): Please pre-stage firmware image and node config for replacements to avoid long reprovision time.
Oliver (sre): I'll tag nodes as "pending-replace" and create shorter reprovision playbook. If arrival stagger >24h, fallback to smaller instance types.
Hana (logistics): Do we want full declared value insurance? Standard practice is 110% for air. Confirm.
Devin (procurement): Yes, insure 110%. Vendor to add PO number and sign customs POA if vendor can.
Anna (vendor-ops): Vendor confirms 110% insurance. PO updated, AWB email will be shared to finance + ops.
Michaela (ops): Action list: 1) Approve AMS + 3 air (Devin) 2) Reserve loaners (Michaela) 3) SRE pre-stage images (Oliver) 4) Vendor final AWB+COO (Anna). Target close: 2024-06-12.
Devin (procurement): Approved. Charge expedite to Q2 buffer budget. :thumbsup:
Anna (vendor-ops): AWB email sent to procurement and ops, tracking 987-6543210. Will update on customs clearance.
Michaela (ops): Please update thread when AWB scans into AMS hub, will mark resolved after physical receive.
VendorBot: Shipment scanned into NL-AMS hub 2024-06-13T09:12Z
Hana (logistics): Scan received, initiating cross-dock hold pending customs docs.
Oliver (sre): If arrival <48h after scan and docs clear, I'll release loaners; otherwise keep reserved.
Michaela (ops): Noted. Thanks everyone — short follow-ups only.
